name: multi-rate-regular-rate
summary: One Illinois worker with two pay rates in a 46-hour week: 30 hours driving a forklift at $20.00/h for client A (Mon–Wed, 10 h a day), then 16 hours of general labor at $17.00/h for client B (Thu–Fri). Straight-time earnings are 30 × $20 + 16 × $17 = $872.00, so the regular rate is $872.00 ÷ 46 h = $18.9565…/h, kept exact (29 C.F.R. § 778.115). The last 6 hours, on Friday at client B, are overtime at $17.00 + ½ × $18.9565… = $26.4782…/h: $158.87. Pay: $600.00 + $170.00 + $158.87 = $928.87 (paying 1.5 × $17.00 instead would underpay $5.87). Bill: A 30 h × $28 = $840.00; B 10 h × $24 = $240.00 and overtime 6 h × $36 = $216.00.

payLines.explain: Regular: 30h 00m (1800 min) × $20.00/h = 60000¢ exactly → $600.00. Rule straight_time: hours up to the 40h 00m weekly threshold in the workweek starting 2026-10-05.
Regular: 10h 00m (600 min) × $17.00/h = 17000¢ exactly → $170.00. Rule straight_time: hours up to the 40h 00m weekly threshold in the workweek starting 2026-10-05.

Overtime: 6h 00m (360 min) × $26.4782…/h ($17.00 + 0.5 × regular rate $18.9565…/h) = 15886.9565…¢ → rounded half-up once → $158.87. Rule weekly_overtime: 46h 00m worked in the workweek starting 2026-10-05 is 6h 00m over the 40h 00m threshold (Illinois Minimum Wage Law, 820 ILCS 105/4a(1) — over 40 hours in a workweek at not less than 1.5x the regular rate; Fair Labor Standards Act, 29 U.S.C. § 207(a)(1); 29 C.F.R. Part 778 — over 40 hours in a workweek at not less than 1.5x the regular rate). 30h 00m of the first 40h 00m were worked on other assignments. Regular rate: $872.00 earned at straight time ÷ 46h 00m worked = $18.9565…/h, used unrounded (29 C.F.R. § 778.115; § 778.111(a)).

billLines.explain: Billed regular: 30h 00m (1800 min) × $28.00/h = 84000¢ exactly → $840.00. Bill rate from the rate card.
Billed regular: 10h 00m (600 min) × $24.00/h = 24000¢ exactly → $240.00. Bill rate from the rate card.

Billed overtime: 6h 00m (360 min) × $36.00/h (1.5 × $24.00 bill rate) = 21600¢ exactly → $216.00. Client bills overtime at the rate-card overtime multiplier; bill rate from the rate card. 30h 00m of the first 40h 00m were worked on other assignments.
